title: Nightly roll call
body: The radio crackles on schedule. Drivers check in. Most of the names you expected. One you did not: VANTABLACK, Sector 9. There is no Sector 9 on the route sheet.

outcome.text: "Copy." Static. Then nothing. The sheet still has no Sector 9. You file it under flavor.
Eleven seconds of silence. Then: "There is no Sector 9, Operator. We're in Sector 9." The radio courtesy-clicks off.
